summary: Orchestra BioMed Holdings filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement on November 5, 2026 for a follow-on underwritten public offering of common stock on Nasdaq (OBIO), last traded at $6.00 on November 4, 2026. Pricing, share count, gross proceeds, and the 30-day underwriters' option are left blank pending completion; Piper Sandler, TD Cowen, and BTIG are named bookrunners. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes per the use-of-proceeds section. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch pricing terms, discount to the $6.00 reference, and dilution versus cash runway.
